# Library Imports
```{r library imports}
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(data.table)
library(GGally)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
```

# Data Imports
```{r data imports}
pa_plot_data <- read.csv("../../data/processed/cleaned_data/prop_adair_plot_level.csv")
pp_plot_data <- read.csv("../../data/processed/cleaned_data/prop_picos_plot_level.csv")

factor_cols <- c('block', 'rs', 'prop_type')
# pa_plot_data[, ..factor_cols]
pa_plot_data[, factor_cols] <- lapply(pa_plot_data[, factor_cols], factor)
pp_plot_data[, factor_cols] <- lapply(pp_plot_data[, factor_cols], factor)
```

```{r}
data <- pp_plot_data[, 9:20]
ggpairs(data)
```
# Mixed Models
```{r Clas qPCR}

pa_pcr_mm <- lmer(hlb_ct_adj ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block), data=pa_plot_data)
pp_pcr_mm <- lmer(hlb_ct_adj ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block), data=pp_plot_data)

summary(pa_pcr_mm)
summary(pp_pcr_mm)

anova(pa_pcr_mm)
anova(pp_pcr_mm)

emmeans(pa_pcr_mm, specs = c(~rs, ~prop_type))
emmeans(pp_pcr_mm, specs = c(~rs, ~prop_type))

pa_plot_data$trial <- "pa"
pp_plot_data$trial <- "pp"

combined_data <- rbind(pa_plot_data, pp_plot_data)
combined_data$trial <- factor(combined_data$trial)

pcr_mm <- lmer(hlb_ct_adj ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
anova(pcr_mm)
emmeans(pcr_mm, specs = c(~rs, ~prop_type))

```

```{r cLas qPCR plots}
pcr_hist <- ggplot(data=combined_data, aes(x=hlb_ct_adj, fill=rs))+
        geom_density(alpha=.5)+
        scale_fill_viridis_d(option='F')
pcr_hist
```
```{r Nutrient analysis}
n_mm <- lmer(n_per ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
p_mm <- lmer(p_per ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
k_mm <- lmer(k_per ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
mg_mm <- lmer(mg_per ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
ca_mm <- glmer(ca_per ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data, family=poisson)
s_mm <- lmer(s_per ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
b_mm <- lmer(b_ppm ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
zn_mm <- lmer(zn_ppm ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
mn_mm <- lmer(mn_ppm ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
fe_mm <- lmer(fe_ppm ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
cu_mm <- lmer(cu_ppm ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=combined_data)
```

```{r}
anova(n_mm)
anova(p_mm)
anova(k_mm)
anova(mg_mm)
anova(ca_mm)
anova(s_mm)
anova(b_mm)
anova(zn_mm)
anova(mn_mm)
anova(fe_mm)
anova(cu_mm)

```
